title: stainless steel cook set with utensils
text: stainless steel cook set with utensils. I purchased for my niece as a housewarming gift for her new home.  She just LOVES the set.  She has a professional cook gas stove and says this set performs beautifully.  In all honesty, I am jealous, but just purchased a different set a few months ago. Comes with a stainless steel utensil set she says is great too. Usually they are a bit of a give away. The set does have a rolled edge so pouring doesn't drip.  I would definitely consider this set if you're in the market!

product_metadata.title: Duxtop Professional Stainless Steel Induction Cookware Set, 19PC Kitchen Pots and Pans Set, Heavy Bottom with Impact-bonded Technology
features: FOOD GRADE STAINLESS STEEL & STURDY: Duxtop stainless steel cookware set is made of premium food grade 18/10 stainless steel, which maintains the flavor of the food. Heavy bottom with impact-bonded technology, built to last for a life time.

FAST & EVEN HEATING: Heavy gauge impacted-bonded aluminum encapsulated bottom of the cooking set providesa quick, even and energy-efficient heating. Suitable for all stovetops, such as induction, gas, electric and halogen cooktops—perfect for even the most seasoned cooks.

FEATURES: This kitchen cookware features a classic straight-sided and drip-free pouring design. The stainless steel rivets secure the stylish shaped handle firmly to the pan—safe and durable. Stay-cool perfect-grip handle allows for comfortable handling during cooking. Clear tempered glass lid is easy to monitor your cooking task.

19PC KITCHEN COOKWARE: 1.4-quart & 2.4-quart saucepan with lid, 4-quart casserole with lid, 7.6-quart stockpot with lid, 5.28-quart saute pan with helper and lid, 8-inch & 9.5-inch fry pan, 9.5-inch boiler basket, 9.5-inch steam basket, 2-prong fork & solid spoon & ladle & slotted turner & skimmer, which meets all cooking methods and daily cooking use.
